summary: Proposes TCP Port Service Multiplexer (TCPMUX), a way for future TCP services to be reached by name through one port instead of each getting its own well-known port. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 7805.

eli5.summary: Instead of giving every shop its own street number, there is one front desk that sends you to the right shop when you say its name.

questions: how does the tcp port service multiplexer work
